entries.name: Hoarded Kernel
entries.flavor: Every dwindling ember spares one grain for later. This one remembers why.

entries.name: Gilded Husk
entries.flavor: Painted over what it used to be, and prouder for it.

entries.name: Lacquerclip
entries.flavor: A single clasp, lacquered past its worth and carried anyway.

entries.name: Scavenged Purse
entries.flavor: Whatever the quartermaster didn't want, the pouch took gladly.

entries.name: Bead of Ash
entries.flavor: What the last fire couldn't finish burning, it left behind as currency.

entries.name: Rustloop
entries.flavor: Rings rust; the habit of keeping one does not.

entries.name: Burgeoning Silo
entries.flavor: Full past its seams, and still someone keeps filling it.

entries.name: Holding Coffer
entries.flavor: The roots hold the wall. The coffer holds everything else.

entries.name: Token of the Ledger
entries.flavor: A single page, copied so many times no one remembers the first hand.

entries.name: Locket of Appraisal
entries.flavor: Opened once by an expert, and never quite closed the same way since.

entries.name: Earthpod
entries.flavor: Buried on purpose, dug up on schedule.

entries.name: Pouch of Requisition
entries.flavor: Signed, stamped, and somehow still empty when it arrives.

entries.name: Wandering Trinket
entries.flavor: It rode one spore farther than the garden that grew it.

entries.name: Tended Bloom
entries.flavor: Someone waters it who has no further use for water.

entries.name: Root of the Foundation
entries.flavor: Every wall the garden ever built started as one stubborn root.

entries.name: Seed of the Glut
entries.flavor: Plant enough and eventually the ground stops asking for more.

entries.name: Patched Satchel
entries.flavor: Held together by whoever needed it to hold one more thing.

entries.name: Twinbead
entries.flavor: Grown as one, carried as two, spent as either.

entries.name: Signet of the Coalbed
entries.flavor: Every coin it grants is a coal it stops banking for winter.

entries.name: Signet of Annexation
entries.flavor: Claim the neighbor's yield, and the strength to defend your own thins to pay for it.

entries.name: Twin Sun-Gleaner
entries.flavor: A heavy, golden vessel shaped like a blooming sunflower, forged from solidified sunlight and packed with endless, shimmering seeds.

entries.name: Gilded Bloom
entries.flavor: A heavy, petal-shaped coin of solid silver, inlaid with a single, brilliant diamond at its center.

entries.name: Spore Accumulator
entries.flavor: A dense, translucent sphere of amber-colored mycelium that pulses with stored sunlight, swelling in size as it absorbs ambient energy.

entries.name: Prismatic Unboxing
entries.flavor: A multifaceted diamond container that holds a hidden treasure within its brilliant, shifting facets.

entries.name: Crimson Seedling
entries.flavor: A heavy, calcified lotus bulb that leaks thick, nutrient-rich ichor, turning every fallen foe into a blooming patch of red.

entries.name: Gluttonous Spore-Husk
entries.flavor: A pulsating, necrotized fungal mass that pulses with a sickly golden light, offering immense vitality at the cost of stability.

entries.name: Industrial License
entries.flavor: A heavy, notched pickaxe head forged from Netherite, stamped with a glowing permit of ownership.

entries.name: Gilded Sprout
entries.flavor: A ceramic vessel overflowing with unnaturally vibrant, oversized petals that seem to pulse with the rhythm of a grand announcement.

entries.name: Golden Kernel Coin
entries.flavor: A heavy, butter-slicked corn kernel encased in a thin layer of gold, shaped like a minted coin.

entries.name: Solar Sprout
entries.flavor: A rapid-blooming sunflower core encased in a polished golden frame that pulses with warmth.

entries.name: Gilded Chronometer
entries.flavor: A heavy, ticking sphere of solid gold, suspended by silver wires that pulse with the rhythm of a heartbeat.

entries.name: Edgar's Reliquary
entries.flavor: A silver-cast parcel containing the preserved remains of a high-value corpse, wrapped in heavy metal chains.

entries.name: Frost-Bound Seasonal Bundle
entries.flavor: A crystalline gift box containing frozen botanical specimens, offered at a steep discount to those who can withstand the chill.

entries.name: Sun-Drenched Spore-Pod
entries.flavor: A translucent, glowing bulb that pulses with warmth, containing concentrated solar essence and fertile soil.

entries.name: Gilded Bloom Harvest
entries.flavor: A heavy, petal-shaped medallion cast from solid gold, perpetually shedding fine, shimmering pollen that smells of minted coins.

entries.name: Vascular Siphon
entries.flavor: A network of translucent, pulsing veins encased in a calcified, rot-blackened husk, constantly twitching as if searching for a pulse to drain.

entries.name: Frozen Swan's Ransom
entries.flavor: A delicate, ice-carved swan figurine that, when held, commands the relentless march of the undead.

entries.name: Jade-Spike Vortex
entries.flavor: A jagged shard of emerald jade, carved into the likeness of a spiked desert dweller, drifts weightlessly through the ether. Its core is a concentrated vortex of swirling jade dust and pressurized wind, contained within a translucent, needle-streaked crystalline shell.

entries.name: Spined Canopy Aegis
entries.flavor: A dense, interlocking lattice of hardened cactus needles and thick, waxy membranes that forms a protective dome over the unit.

entries.name: Bursting Cherry Spore
entries.flavor: A pressurized, crimson-stained fungal bulb that releases thick, fragrant clouds of explosive pollen upon impact.

entries.name: Sprout-Burst Tuber
entries.flavor: A heavy, starch-filled bulb encased in a pressurized cherry-blossom shell, ready to burst upon rapid maturation.

entries.name: The Silent Ledger of Lead
entries.flavor: A heavy, ink-stained newsprint wrapped around a leaden cylinder, vibrating with the rhythmic thud of a printing press.

entries.name: Petal-Shot Siphon
entries.flavor: A polished wooden vessel shaped like a blooming cherry branch, containing concentrated nectar that accelerates the flow of resources.

entries.name: Burst-Ripened Spore-Pod
entries.flavor: A semi-ripe cherry-colored fungal bulb, suspended by thick, sticky filaments, ready to detonate upon impact.

entries.name: Crimson Gourd Core
entries.flavor: A dense, explosive sphere of pulpy cherry-flesh encased in a thick, protective pumpkin rind.

entries.name: Gushing Pulp-Cyst
entries.flavor: A swollen, weeping sac of fermented crimson, pulsing with the rhythmic tremor of a hungry, necrotic heart.

entries.name: Ruptured Nectar Husk
entries.flavor: A jagged, crimson-stained shell of fermented pulp and splintered pits, pulsing with a restless, necrotic pressure.

entries.name: Vessel of the Unspent Pulse
entries.flavor: A jagged, hollowed engine block of calcified cherry-wood and rusted iron, still twitching with the kinetic energy of a dying star.

entries.name: Cherry-Torch Stump-Core
entries.flavor: A glowing, resinous knot of cherry-wood and eternal flame, pulsing with the rhythm of a growing forest.

entries.name: Gulping Bloom Vessel
entries.flavor: A translucent, bulbous container shaped like a wide, toothy maw, filled with a viscous, bubbling digestive fluid that provides sustenance to those nearby.

entries.name: Autumnal Essence Graft
entries.flavor: A pressed, bruised petal encased in amber-like resin, pulsing with the concentrated vitality of a dying field.

entries.name: Kernel-Burst Siphon
entries.flavor: A heavy, pressurized canister made of hardened corn husks and brass, designed to launch golden kernels with explosive force.

entries.name: Unfinished Eraser-Stub
entries.flavor: A blunt, rubbery cylinder that refuses to acknowledge its own failure.

entries.name: Golden Kernel Suspension
entries.flavor: A cluster of floating, butter-slicked kernels that drift through the air to provide sustenance.

entries.name: Golden Kernel Pouch
entries.flavor: A heavy, grease-slicked pouch filled with bouncing kernels that spill out with rhythmic force.

entries.name: Brass-Casing Volley
entries.flavor: A collection of spent, polished brass casings that rattle with the rhythm of a firing pin.

entries.name: Spore-Sown Relinquishment
entries.flavor: A heavy, fungal-encrusted base of decayed corn-stalks and zombie-flesh, designed to launch spores in exchange for stability.

entries.name: 伞叶覆膜
entries.flavor: 由僵尸组织而成的伞叶，覆有厚重的腐肉层，能将冲击击退并定格在原地。

entries.name: Spore-Clotted Tuber-Core
entries.flavor: A dense, pulsating mass of fermented starch and necrotic matter, held together by the sheer force of concentrated decay.

entries.name: Fractured Yield-Shard
entries.flavor: A jagged, unstable cluster of mimic-diamonds that pulses with the rhythm of a sudden windfall, though its very presence invites a catastrophic collapse.

entries.name: Carapace of the Prismatic Tuber
entries.flavor: A dense, faceted kernel of earth-grown diamond, hard as a mountain and rich as a treasury.

entries.name: Luminous Nested Core
entries.flavor: A geometric prism of light, shaped like a world within a world, crafted from the essence of a zombie's radiant spirit.

entries.name: Dolphin-Whale Gyro-Shell
entries.flavor: A polished, white-pearl shell shaped like a leaping dolphin, spinning rapidly to release a rhythmic pulse of wealth.

entries.name: Aquarium Keeper's Part-Time Ledger
entries.flavor: A heavy, water-logged ledger bound in preserved skin, containing the unpaid wages of those who serve the deep.

entries.name: Cinder-Leaf Reliquary
entries.flavor: A scorched, three-lobed vessel of calcified ash and drifting down, releasing a cloud of choking soot upon every strike.

entries.name: Spore-Lineage Manual-Burst
entries.flavor: A heavy, hand-cranked piston made of calcified fungal matter that forces a continuous, devastating stream of spores across the entire battlefield.

entries.name: Carcass-Burst Bulb
entries.flavor: A swollen, pungent bulb of fermented remains that ruptures with a violent, stinking pop upon impact.

entries.name: Spore-Casing Volley-Core
entries.flavor: A heavy, four-chambered fungal canister, pulsating with the pressure of a thousand spent shells.

entries.name: Searing Seed-Core
entries.flavor: A dormant, swollen bulb of concentrated spice that pulses with internal heat, waiting for the moment of total combustion.

entries.name: Vines of Ruin
entries.flavor: A mass of dark, suffocating aquatic flora that constricts and drains the life from everything it touches.

entries.name: Isotope-Core Husk
entries.flavor: A dense, lead-lined shell containing a pulsating, radioactive kernel that absorbs kinetic impact to fuel its internal reaction.
